title: yizhiyanhua-ai/fireworks-tech-graph

zh.gap: Mermaid 一脉画得对但难看；设计工具画得好看但慢。缺口是：在普通人真愿意花的那十秒里，出一张干净、能见人的图，而且中文要和英文一样好（Mermaid 的中日韩排版至今很差）。
zh.pain: 需要一张说得清楚的图、但自己不会画的老师、分析师、写科普的人。
zh.kill: 文字转图正在被每一个聊天助手吸收成默认功能，独立工具大概只有一年窗口——除非它拥有一种别人叫得出名字的具体图风。
zh.move: 不要做「什么图都能画」，去占住某一类人的图语言：中学理科老师的学案配图，或者中文场景下 Mermaid 至今排不好的那种排版规整的幻灯配图。冷启动：中文＝小红书「教师备课」「PPT 配图」标签下的求助帖；英文＝r/Teachers 与 r/PowerPoint 的「这张图怎么做」。

gap: Mermaid and its kin produce something correct and ugly; design tools produce something beautiful and slow. The gap is one clean, presentable figure produced in the ten seconds a normal person will actually spend, in Chinese as well as English (Mermaid's CJK layout is still bad).
pain: The teacher, the analyst, the person writing a public-facing explainer who needs one clear diagram and cannot draw.
kill: Diagram-from-text is being absorbed into every chat assistant as a default feature, so a standalone tool has maybe a year unless it owns a specific figure style people can recognise and ask for by name.
move: Own one audience's figure vocabulary rather than 'any diagram': the middle-school science teacher's worksheet figure, or the CN-market slide diagram with proper CJK typesetting that Mermaid still botches. Cold start CN = 小红书「教师备课」「PPT 配图」标签下的求助帖; EN = r/Teachers and r/PowerPoint 'how do I make this diagram' posts.
